gain_error_decomposition.scope: Exact squared-error decomposition over saved three-start gain values per fresh world; descriptive, no new fitted predictor or counterfactual native execution.

reading_scope: Fixed saved-result arithmetic only. No additional native/static queries, fits, model forwards, or independent train replication. All worlds retained; sign counts use 1e-12 zero tolerance. Native branch values exist only for executed G/L/P layouts, not all three possible starts.

selected_raw_trajectory_reading.scope: Post-result descriptive tails, not selection or extra evaluation; six worlds include strongest J loss/gain, both largest opposing coverage examples, paid fallback, and static/native sign reversal.
